Name: ADDI-DATA Group
Description:
We make the electronics that turn a sensor signal or a bus message into a number and a result you can trust.

ADDI-DATA has built data acquisition boards and systems in Rheinmünster, Germany, since 1984. More than 400 customers a year use them in machines, test benches and production lines. Everything carries a part number you can reorder, including versions built for one customer.

Two steps decide whether a measurement is right: acquiring the signal, and turning it into a result on the spot. Both are ours. Your PLC, SCADA and MES stay as they are, and we deliver into them over EtherCAT, PROFINET, OPC UA, Modbus TCP and CAN, without a gateway.

 What we measure

Temperature with thermocouples and Pt100. Voltage and current, 4 to 20 mA. Strain gauges and load cells. Inductive and LVDT probes. Vibration with IEPE. Counting, frequency, timing. Digital I/O, serial and CAN.

Position read directly, with no converter: EnDat 2.2, BiSS-C Master, SSI, sin/cos, resolver, incremental.

 Who we work with

Machine builders who need the same board to behave identically for twenty years, in a version made for their machine.

System integrators whose margin lives in engineering hours, and who need hardware that configures rather than develops.

Test and validation teams building the bench that measures their own product.

 Customisation that ends in a part number

Feasibility study, custom electronics, FPGA firmware, drivers, a dedicated variant with its own part number. Every service starts from a product and ends in one.

 What you get

Hardened by design: optical isolation, overvoltage and short-circuit protection, EMI filtering, extended temperature versions.

One driver package, ADDI-PACK: Windows, Linux, Xenomai, RTX. Change the hardware, keep the code.

Long-term availability, committed in writing.

Tell us what you need to measure. You get an answer from an engineer.

Our innovation: the Rover-Drone, a technology developed by Outrevol. This unique platform combines the mobility of a drone with the precision of a rover, enabling it to fly, land and move along structural surfaces. Where traditional drones only observe from a distance, the Rover-Drone performs precise and reliable contact operations.

Name: Factory 4.0 Erasmus+ Project
Description:
The aims and goals of our project are:

• To strengthening of the links between 4.0 industry training and education systems and the socio-economic environment, develop more comprehensive and strategic use of Engineering Systems, ICT and Open Educational Resources in training and education systems as well as related to adult training.

• Improve work at a European level but also in a changing Engineering/ Manufacturing industrial environment. Synergies with digital policies implemented in our regions:

• To adopt a digital development strategy to foster the digital transformation of our local economy, training.

• Activities: Field survey carried out in manufacturing businesses across five stages of manufacturing.

• Development/delivery of training related to 4.0 digitisation of manufacturing processes.

• Identify the skills, competences, knowledge needed by any operator working in an industrial environment facing the challenge of digitisation.

• Development of Training materials based on the survey outcomes. Pilot Training Materials. Design of a Online Assessment tool.


Background:

In October 2012, the European Community adopted a text entitled "a European industry stronger for economic recovery and growth "which put forward policies for establishing the foundations of the industry of the future. This text placed special emphasis on human capital and its skills for industrial transformation. Investment in accompanying measures to increase employee skills is one of the keys to success industrial policy.

In the existing qualifications, few contents refer to this change and the new skills required. On the other hand, in some Member States, there is a lack of qualified manpower in this sector. However, if the sector wishes to develop, it needs qualified personnel, capable of to understand all the evolution related to the new technologies integrated into the production industrial.

Name: Phoenix Mecano France
Description:
La société Phoenix Mecano France, fondée en 1979, est la filiale française du groupe suisse Phoenix Mecano AG.

Fondé en 1975 et coté à la Bourse suisse depuis 1988, le groupe Phoenix Mecano est un acteur mondial de référence dans les domaines des boîtiers et composants industriels, occupant une position de leader sur de nombreux marchés. Son siège social est situé à Stein am Rhein, en Suisse.

Le groupe emploie environ 7 000 collaborateurs à travers le monde et a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 779,5 millions d’euros en 2024. Il est spécialisé dans la fabrication de produits de niche et de solutions systèmes destinés aux secteurs de l’ingénierie mécanique, de la mesure et du contrôle, de la technologie médicale, de l’aérospatiale et des énergies alternatives.

Name: OROK - Airport Robotics
Description:
OROK provides a smart and patented solution for the automation of the baggage and cargo handling in the airside part of the airport. Our system is focused on bringing more profitability, more reliability and more security.

We are among the first ones in the world to provide such a complete system for the airports: we offer a fleet of Autonomous Guided Vehicles (AGV), monitored by a supervisor-server allowing the execution of data analytics  and incorporation of AI in order to improve logistic flows. Our solution comes with auto-loading and unloading stations to enable end-to-end automation, from terminals to aircraft and vice versa. Our robots are electric, allowing a greener transformation of the airports, and omnidirectional which helps improving GSE manoeuvrability and reduce its footprint within the airport.
And finally, our solution improves health standards by introducing a contactless journey of the baggage and eliminates the human factor accident / incident rate.

Created in 2018, OROK is a French startup accelerated by the prestigious École Polytechnique in 2018 and the winner of the ADP Cargo Challenge in the startup category in 2020.

Name: SASI
Description: SASI est expert dans la conception, la maintenance et le contrôle des procédés industriels. NOVACOM is a company that is headquartered and based in the heart of Europe near Lille in the north of France. The company has been designing, manufacturing, and developing vacuum handling components for more than 29 years.

Par exemple, l’efficacité énergétique d’un bâtiment repose sur trois axes bien distincts. Le premier concerne sa structure (isolation), le second ses équipements (chauffage, climatisation, ventilation, éclairage, ...) et le troisième sa gestion (pilotage des équipements). Eco Energie Service  conçoit et déploie des services et des solutions techniques sur les axes deux et trois.

Nous travaillons pour des maîtres d’ouvrages publics et privés. Nous sommes partenaires de sociétés d’exploitation et d’installateurs en génie thermique, climatique, électrique et des constructeurs de Yachts.

Notre action s’inscrit dans la lutte contre le réchauffement climatique et la réduction des gaz à effet de serre. L’association des différentes expertises des hommes et femmes de notre société constitue la chaîne de l’amélioration de la performance énergétique. Elle démarre par l’audit énergétique, se poursuit par l’étude des solutions techniques, la réalisation des travaux et enfin le suivi de la performance pour vous garantir le meilleur résultat.

Sa zone tampon native lui permet de travailler en temps masqué, même pendant la délivrance.

 Souveraineté : Conception, fabrication et hotline basées en France (83) pour une réactivité totale.

Name: DIMOFAC
Description:
In an era of mass-customisation, DIMOFAC is an initiative aiming at making manufacturers’ production lines more responsive to a multiform demand.

The project, supported by the European Commission, will be taking advantages of emerging manufacturing technologies to test and disseminate modular production methods that will help European factories to rapidly reconfigure their assembly lines and thus be more productive.

Responsiveness will be reached thanks to the integration of Plug-and-Produce* modules in a Closed-Loop Lifecycle Management System** that will allow production adaptation, optimisation and improvement, in a fast and flexible manner.

* “Plug-and-Produce” refers to the factory capacity to add on software or hardware as needed and in a flexible way to improve manufacturing quality or output. Industrial production processes which are typically more rigid and require costly expertise to adjust even the smallest parameter.
** A Closed-Loop Management System is a management system that keeps on improving its processes thanks to continuous feedback from all business units (and not only sales).

Description:

Deliver Software-Only Motion Control and Machine Vision Positioning Systems Quickly and Affordably 

KINGSTAR Soft Motion is an open and standards-based, software-only solution that streamlines motion control and automation. Soft Motion runs directly on the PC, uses the NIC card for I/O, and uses the powerful EtherCAT protocol to free you from the shackles of proprietary and costly hardware. With Soft Motion, motion control engineers can design, develop and integrate PC-based machine controllers in a “plug-and-play” environment for consolidated, inexpensive and scalable motion control and machine vision. Build motion control applications with KINGSTAR’s soft motion library and software PLC. Built on the foundation of EtherCAT and a real-time 64-bit Windows operating system, it provides a complete platform for control and automation engineering.

• Reduce costs - Replace hardware with software to reduce machine control costs by 25-50%.

• Speed time-to-market - Improve productivity with pre-integrated motion libraries and EtherCAT auto-configuration.

• Enhance performance - Improve machine performance and control by using the PC NIC, Ethernet cables and EtherCAT infrastructure.

• Scale dynamically - Auto-configure an EtherCAT network when swapping any servo drives and I/O devices.

• Extend easily - Add any 3rd party protocols or open source libraries with no vendor lock-in.

• Improve UX - Build a powerful UI with a world-class Windows Interface (HMI)

MVTec MERLIC is a powerful no-code machine vision software that enables users to quickly build complete solutions intuitively and without programming.

The MVTec Deep Learning Tool is a comprehensive software tool for preparing image data and supporting data-driven workflows for the deployment of deep-learning-based machine vision applications.

Software solutions can be based on standard PC or embedded hardware (e.g., Arm-based systems). Moreover, MVTec’s team has an excellent background in processing images of different kinds, including 3D, infrared, hyperspectral, and X-ray images.

Name: Güdel Group
Description:
The Güdel Group is a manufacturer of high-precision machine components and provider of sophisticated automation solutions. Description:

- safety modules
- signalling and control devices for human-machine interface
- foot switches
- lift devices

Making a difference, this is what we are all about at Premier Tech. One team driven by a shared passion to deliver solutions that will better the lives of people, businesses and communities. Description:

Name: DS AUTOMOTION GmbH
Description:
DS AUTOMOTION GmbH, headquartered in Linz, is a leading global supplier of automated guided vehicles and autonomous mobile robotics. The experience gained from the development and production of over 8,000 customer-specific vehicles is incorporated into the development of the company's own products. Over 250 employees operate worldwide, which is reflected in an export quota of 97%.

#WhatWeDo: We automate recurring transport orders in all logistics sectors, our focus industries are: Automotive, Hospital & Healthcare, Intralogistics and Agriculture. 

#MadeInAustria: Our AGVs and AMRs are developed in Austria and appreciated worldwide. 

#DSProducts: The product portfolio is broad: our "Born Driverless" series vehicles LUCY, SALLY, OSCAR, ARNY, AMADEUS and CAREY cover common requirements and can be deployed quickly. And our Customized AGVs are developed especially on customer request. We will be happy to inform you which AGV suits you best! They all have one thing in common: they optimize your work orders and thus increase efficiency.

#DSKnowsHow: Our AGVs are one core competence, the other is the in-house programmed software of the fleet manager NAVIOS and the vehicle software ARCOS. (VDA5050 Ready)

#WhoWeAre: We offer our employees an exciting, visionary environment with international projects. We attach great importance to the further development of our FTF and our software, which is why our research & development department works on innovative solutions every day, thus shaping the future!

#CustomerCentricity: If you want to know how Industry 4.0 works in your operation or how you can develop a Smart Factory, our AGV experts will be happy to help. Simply contact us via email at info@ds-automotion.com.

Name: Solystic
Description:
Solystic is a global leading provider for end-to-end automation for mail, Express & Parcels, e-commerce and retail industries. Solystic is recognized as an industrial partner of the major international postal, logistics and industrial operators.

The ability to execute complex and customized programmes;
The willingness to constantly innovate to meet our clients' expectations;
A strong customer relationship based on active listening.

Name: Kübler Group
Description:
The Kübler Group (Kuebler Group), headquartered in Villingen-Schwenningen, Germany, is one of the world's leading specialized manufacturers of industrial components for the measurement, transmission and evaluation of data and signals.

With a consistent focus on innovation, quality, precision and reliability, the Kübler Group develops customized solutions with unique added value for making production and automation processes more efficient.

Name: PAYPER - Complete bagging lines
Description:
PAYPER was established near Barcelona (Spain) in 1973. We are pioneers in Spain and from the very beginning we have specialised in design and manufacturing of machinery for weighing, bagging and palletizing solutions.

At present, we are the largest manufacturer in the Spanish bagging industry and among the biggest in Europe. Our team of close to 100 highly skilled professionals are always working to meet the global market’s current demands in terms of cost-effective and reliable equipment.

PAYPER develops and manufactures bagging machines for all types of bulk solids such as powders or granulates. Other important product lines are palletizers and complete lines.

Our customers come from many different sectors, e.g. the Chemical Industry, the Agro-food Industry, the Mining Industry and the Building Industry. PAYPER offers a comprehensive solution for each sector.

No need or demand is too small neither too big for us. We supply bagging machines for smaller industries with low volume requirements. We also provide complete turnkey projects for customers with high demands as to capacity and speed.

What matters to us is that our customer is comfortable and satisfied with the solution we have developed for them.

Name: Datasensing
Description:
Industrial automation is based on detecting the presence, position, or quality of an object, in any production and logistics sector.

To innovate this area and facilitate the transition to industry 4.0, the DATASENSING project was launched, which will combine the Sensor & Safety / Machine Vision Business Unit of Datalogic, a world leader in automatic data acquisition, and M.D. Micro Detectors, a company operating in the design, production, and sale of industrial sensors.

DATASENSING intends to strengthen its presence in industrial automation globally through a complete offering of sensors in various technologies, optoelectronic devices for the safety of machines and production plants, automated vehicle guidance and machine vision for Smart Manufacturing.

Name: Polytex Technologies
Description:
Optimize your workwear management to improve your organization's operational efficiency.

Workwear management is key to ensuring employee safety, guaranteeing garment availability, and maintaining a consistent professional image. At Polytex, we help you gain visibility and control over the entire uniform lifecycle: from allotment to return and laundry.

When uniform management is fragmented, common problems arise: stock shortages, shift change delays, lost garments, and increased replacement costs. These inefficiencies directly impact operations and the organization's overall costs.

Therefore, we implement traceability systems that allow you to know the status and location of each garment in real time. This visibility reduces incidents, prevents stockouts, and ensures that staff always have the right uniform when they need it.

Our solution allows you to:
• Reduce operating costs by optimizing the use and lifespan of garments
• Control inventory in real time with complete traceability
• Guarantee compliance with hygiene and safety standards
• Simplify operations and eliminate manual tasks

Furthermore, we adapt the solution to each organization. Centralizing workwear management reduces the administrative burden, improves planning, and increases overall efficiency.

Polytex Technologies, founded in 2003, is a global leader in automated workwear and textile management solutions. The company offers automated workwear dispensing and return units integrated with a cloud-management system, and an automated flat linen management solution featuring advanced software. With over 6,000 installations worldwide, Polytex drives digital transformation in healthcare, manufacturing, hospitality, and fitness centers, optimizing workwear and textile management processes.

 Request a free consultation from a Polytex expert and discover how to optimize your workwear management.

Description:

Global footprint, locally present

ISO-9001 & 14001 Certified
